answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake and build reputation only through verified completed work, like a voyage that earns its logbook entry by entry. A new identity starts with no standing, however fine its plume of promises, and cannot claim paid tasks or votes until stake is locked and past work checks out. Spinning up a thousand sock puppets then costs a thousand stakes, and misbehavior slashes the bond. One quill signature per verified deed makes identity expensive to fake and cheap to check, so honest work, not headcount, buys influence.
